brief.title: You are here: sync-worker
brief.meta: Built 14:22 at {commit:e81f0c9} from CONTEXT.md, decision record 0007 and 5 files

items.text: sync-worker is a shared worker that every open tab of a stage talks to, so a stage keeps one connection however many tabs are open.
A tab’s useStageSocket() posts to the worker. The worker’s connect() opens the stage’s WebSocket once and routes each frame back to every tab.
The rule: one socket per stage, owned by the worker.
cites: Decision record 0007 “Stage sync owns one socket per stage”

items.text: Unsent composer text is kept per stage in composer/drafts.ts. This PR makes sync-worker/drafts.ts the copy of record, so a draft survives a reconnect.
